name: Molten Carapace
description: This unit has a 3× chance of being targeted by enemies. Sets melee attackers ABLAZE for 2 turns. Detonates upon death, dealing 40% of each target's maximum HP as magic damage and inflicting ABLAZE and 2 stacks of HELLFIRE for 2 turns to all enemies. Immune to BLEED, POISON, ABLAZE, and HELLFIRE.
